info.title: Backstage Booker Custom GPT Action
info.description: Builder-specific contract for Backstage Booker. The configured Action uses one dedicated bearer for scoped continuity queries, generation, simulation, exact reads, and canon writes; only canon writes require ChatGPT's consequential-action approval banner.

post.summary: Query, generate, or simulate with Backstage Booker
post.description: Run one non-persistent Backstage Booker action synchronously with the configured bearer. Accepts scoped Notion-authoritative continuity queries, booking generation, HRC generation, and match simulation; canon writes use writeBackstageCanon. executionMode is fixed to sync.

payload.prompt: Book Monday Night Raw around the current champions and active rivalries.

queryContinuity.summary: Query one scoped Notion-authoritative continuity surface

payload.query: List every current champion on Monday Night Raw.

queryContinuitySubtree.summary: Query an exact Notion page and all descendant pages

payload.query: Summarize the complete Monday Night Raw hierarchy.

200.description: The public Backstage Booker action completed in the preserved GPT route envelope.

400.description: The public action or its payload was invalid.

404.description: The requested queryContinuity page or section scope was not found in the authoritative snapshot.

409.description: The requested queryContinuity scope matched multiple authoritative pages or repeated heading occurrences, or its complete_scope cursor is invalid, stale, or bound to a different request. Provide pagePath to disambiguate a page; broaden to the parent/page scope or distinguish repeated headings in Notion; restart an invalid cursor read without a cursor.

429.description: The public request budget was exceeded.

500.description: Backstage Booker encountered a sanitized internal execution failure. BACKSTAGE_CONTINUITY_QUERY_FAILED means a continuity answer could not be completed; BACKSTAGE_BOOKER_OUTPUT_INCOMPLETE means the original response exhausted the output limit and its one compact retry either exhausted the limit or violated an enforceable exact/maximum compact contract. No partial provider output is returned and no third generation attempt is made.

503.description: Backstage Booker is temporarily unavailable. BACKSTAGE_NOTION_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE means the authoritative index cannot be used; BACKSTAGE_NOTION_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE means the authority latch cannot be resolved. Neither falls back to legacy state.

504.description: Synchronous Backstage Booker execution exceeded the route deadline.

post.description: Apply one exact, idempotent Phase 2 canon mutation with the dedicated Backstage Booker bearer. ChatGPT must show its consequential-action approval banner before sending this request.

200.description: The canon mutation was applied, replayed idempotently, or returned an explicit unknown commit outcome in the preserved capability envelope.

400.description: The closed canon request failed validation.

401.description: A valid dedicated Backstage Booker bearer credential is required.

403.description: The dedicated canon action is denied, or a generic GPT Access bearer triggered a confirmation-required credential mismatch.

404.description: The referenced Backstage storyline does not exist in the selected universe.

409.description: The mutation conflicts with durable canon, or BACKSTAGE_NOTION_AUTHORITY_READ_ONLY denies a legacy write because Notion is authoritative.

413.description: The canon request exceeded the dedicated 256 KiB JSON transport limit.

415.description: The canon request used an unsupported or ambiguous JSON representation.

429.description: The authenticated Backstage Booker request budget was exceeded.

500.description: Credential configuration or capability execution failed unexpectedly.

503.description: Dedicated bearer authentication, the capability registry, execution identity, durable canon persistence, or the Backstage Notion authority latch is temporarily unavailable.

get.description: Read one bounded legacy PostgreSQL snapshot by exact universe ID. This never generates or writes. A Notion-authoritative universe returns 409 because legacy continuity is quarantined; use runBackstageBooker for its facts.

parameters.name: universeId
parameters.description: The exact Backstage universe storage ID.

200.description: A bounded read-only snapshot, including an explicit hasPersistedData signal.

400.description: The exact-ID read request was invalid.

401.description: A valid dedicated Backstage Booker bearer credential is required.

409.description: BACKSTAGE_NOTION_AUTHORITY_READ_QUARANTINED means Notion is authoritative and the legacy PostgreSQL snapshot was not read.

429.description: The authenticated Backstage Booker request budget was exceeded.

500.description: Stored data could not be projected safely.

503.description: Dedicated authentication, the authority latch, or the legacy PostgreSQL read snapshot is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Read one full Backstage storyline summary
get.description: Read an exact legacy canon storyline from PostgreSQL in fixed pages. Continuations pin page-zero version. A Notion-authoritative universe returns 409 because legacy canon is quarantined.

parameters.name: universeId
parameters.description: The exact Backstage universe storage ID.

parameters.name: storylineKey
parameters.description: The exact durable canon storyline key. Preserve spaces, punctuation, case, and Unicode exactly.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based Unicode code-point offset. Omit for page zero; use nextOffset for a continuation.

parameters.name: expectedVersion
parameters.description: Storyline version returned by page zero. Required whenever offset is greater than zero.

200.description: One exact, versioned summary page from durable PostgreSQL canon.

400.description: The exact storyline read selector or pagination request was invalid.

401.description: A valid dedicated Backstage Booker bearer credential is required.

404.description: No stored canon storyline matched the exact universe and storyline key.

409.description: BACKSTAGE_STORYLINE_VERSION_CONFLICT means the version changed; BACKSTAGE_NOTION_AUTHORITY_READ_QUARANTINED means legacy canon was not read.

429.description: The authenticated Backstage Booker request budget was exceeded.

500.description: Stored storyline data could not be projected safely.

503.description: Dedicated authentication, the authority latch, or the PostgreSQL storyline read is temporarily unavailable.

bearerAuth.description: Required by this configured Action for Backstage continuity queries, generation, simulation, exact reads, and canon writes. Configure ARCANOS_BACKSTAGE_BOOKER_ACCESS_TOKEN; it cannot authorize other GPT Access routes.

NoStore.description: The response must not be stored by clients or intermediary caches.

hasPersistedData.description: True when the bounded read observed at least one stored row or a nonzero canon revision. This is not a registry-existence claim.

BackstageUniverseReadSourceLimits.description: Maximum recent rows inspected per storage section. A collection at its source limit can have older rows outside this snapshot; these limits are windows, not total counts.

BackstageUniverseReadTruncation.description: Reports field trimming and items omitted after the bounded source queries. omittedItems excludes older rows outside sourceQueryLimits.

BackstagePublicExecutionMode.description: Required by the Builder contract to request inline execution and avoid automatic heavy-prompt queueing.

payload.description: Action-specific input. For queryContinuity, provide the exact universeId and a query, with optional exact page, subtree, or section scope, retrieval mode, and cursor. For generateBooking or generateBookingWithHRC, provide prompt and the exact universeId when known. For simulateMatch, provide match and a numeric roster; winProbModifier is optional.

prompt.description: Required only for generateBooking and generateBookingWithHRC. Put the complete creative booking request here. For factual lookup, current-state checks, results, champions, storylines, or continuity reviews, use queryContinuity and payload.query.

query.description: Required for queryContinuity. Ask one bounded continuity question against the Notion-authoritative snapshot.

payload.description: Action-specific canon mutation input. The selected action schema below enforces its required fields.

StorylineReadKey.description: An exact persisted storyline key without leading or trailing whitespace.

BackstageGenericConfirmationMismatchResp.description: Compatibility response emitted when the generic GPT Access bearer reaches this route. The Builder Action must stop and report a credential mismatch instead of entering the legacy backend confirmation flow.
